title: Folio stack
description: Three graphic folios pin and recede as the next cover enters the reading area.
useCase: Present a short sequence with spatial continuity and native scrolling.
reducedMotion: Sticky positioning remains; scale, dimming and smooth programmatic scrolling are removed.
limitations: Three authored covers inside a bounded scroll area; not a virtualized list or page scroll controller.
look: Dark slate page with stacked full-width poster cards in red, off-white and cobalt, heavy sans titles, small monospace captions and geometric line art.
motion: Covers pin with CSS sticky in 12 px steps; as the next one scrolls over, the pinned cover scales to 0.91 and dims 20%, and an arrow button smooth-scrolls onward.
adapt: Stacking is CSS: `.fs-slot` is `position:sticky` with `top` offset by index; the recede effect is the `update` handler mapping the next card's distance to `depth`, then `scale` and `brightness`. Replace `names`, `colors`, `inks` and the SVG covers.
